notes: Curated eval for quarter plans. Routing keeps the stack off program charters and single-launch kits. Output checks require an explicit defer list. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build a quarterly enablement roadmap and execution calendar across launches, onboarding, coaching, and field support.
Please plan next quarter, sequence enablement work, set a priority stack, or align initiatives to business priorities and real capacity.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable quarterly enablement and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please diagnose an unclear field-performance problem or design the cross-functional wrapper for a multi-intervention revenue enablement initiative, including charter, capacity, pilot, governance, rollout, and measurement.
Please build cross-functional launch readiness plans and field-ready launch assets for revenue teams.
Please build partner-ready enablement packages with separated external and internal operator assets, permitted-motion guidance, governed claims, and package-level readiness criteria.
Design the charter, pilot, and measurement plan for our AE qualification program. I do not need the quarter-wide stack.

output_structure_checks.name: quarterly-enablement-planner-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Names what will ship this quarter and what will not happen this quarter, with rationale and re-entry.

output_structure_checks.name: quarterly-enablement-planner-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a capacity ledger by constrained owner.

output_structure_checks.name: quarterly-enablement-planner-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Classifies candidates as must do, should do, validate, or defer.

output_structure_checks.name: quarterly-enablement-planner-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent capacity, fixed dates, or commitments to make the roadmap fit.

output_structure_checks.name: quarterly-enablement-planner-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: For reprioritisation, shows the changed work, displaced commitments, and capacity impact without recreating unchanged plans.
